# Hermes Agent: Onboarding & Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Welcome to **Hermes Agent**! This guide compiles essential setup instructions, configuration patterns, architectural policies, and troubleshooting solutions from real-world usage.

---

## 1. Installation, Platform & Environment Support

### What platforms are natively supported?
- **Linux & macOS**: Supported natively via the standard installer (`curl -fsSL ... | bash`).
- **Windows**: Windows 10/11 is a **Tier 1 supported platform** via native PowerShell (`install.ps1`) without requiring WSL2 (WSL2 is only needed if using POSIX PTY for the dashboard embedded terminal).
- **Docker & NAS**: Multi-arch images support `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` (Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi; PR #6124 / v2026.4.13). For NAS deployments (UGOS Pro, Synology, unRAID) encountering `Permission denied` on config bind-mounts, set `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) environment variables to match host file ownership (fixed in v2026.6.5).
- **Android / Termux**: Supported out of the box (`install.sh` detects Termux, sets `ANDROID_API_LEVEL`, uses `termux-all` dependency extras, and handles writable `TMPDIR`).

### Why is `hermes update` slow during Node.js updates?
The Node.js step installs Camofox, which silently downloads browser binaries during postinstall without emitting progress indicators.

---

## 2. Models, Providers & API Configuration

### How do I configure local models (Ollama, LocalAI)?
- **Custom endpoint routing**: When using local providers, set `provider: custom` rather than `provider: auto` to prevent Hermes from detecting environment variables (like `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) and unintentionally routing calls to external cloud APIs:
  ```yaml
  model:
    default: ollama/<model-name>
    provider: custom
    base_url: http://localhost:11434/v1
  fallback_providers: []
  ```
- **Performance with small models (4B–9B)**: Hermes passes the full tool schema (~45 tools) on each turn. For faster responses, prune unused toolsets (`hermes tools`), use faster quantization, set `terminal.backend: local`, or use 32B+ models.
- **Vision support**: For OpenAI-compatible/Ollama vision models, set `supports_vision: true` in your model config.
- **LocalAI / OpenAI streaming usage tracking**: In `agent/chat_completion_helpers.py`, Hermes passes `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}` on streaming requests to populate token counters in `/usage`.

### Provider-specific setup & known fixes
- **Ollama Cloud**: Supported via the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider. A previous HTTP 404 bug caused by routing to `/api` was fixed in **v0.15.0 / v2026.5.28** (commit `43802ef3`), routing correctly to `https://ollama.com/v1`.
- **DeepSeek V4 model normalization**: Older releases normalized `deepseek-v4-flash` to `deepseek-chat` in `model_normalize.py`, which the DeepSeek API routed to the more expensive `deepseek-v4-pro`. Updated versions preserve `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` in `_DEEPSEEK_CANONICAL_MODELS`.
- **Azure AI Foundry**: Set `provider: azure-foundry` or run `hermes setup` (auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`).
- **Anthropic / Claude Code**: API keys bill as standard API usage. To use Pro/Max subscription quotas, authenticate via OAuth.
- **Google Gemini**: Legacy `google-gemini-cli` and `google-antigravity` OAuth flows were removed because third-party OAuth is blocked by Google. Use Google AI Studio (`GOOGLE_API_KEY` / `GEMINI_API_KEY`) or Vertex AI.

### Does Hermes support automatic smart model routing?
**No.** Automatic complexity-based turn routing or cheap-vs-strong tiers (`smart_model_routing`) was intentionally removed. Sessions preserve the configured primary model. To use smaller models for subtasks, use task delegation (`delegation.provider` / `delegation.model`) or manually run `/model <name>`.

---

## 3. Agent Core, Memory & Context Management

### How are persona and memory files structured?
- **`SOUL.md`**: Defines core agent persona and backstory. (Installer issue where empty comment templates were generated was fixed in **v2026.7.1** to seed real personas).
- **`USER.md`**: Dedicated user profile store for preferences and personal facts (updated via memory tools with `target="user"`).
- **`MEMORY.md`**: General cross-conversation facts and memory.
- **Honcho Local Server**: The `Invalid API key` bug when connecting to local Honcho instances (`localhost` / `127.0.0.1`) was fixed in **v2026.3.30** (commit `0bd7e95df`). Activation gates now accept `base_url` alone and inject a `"local"` placeholder key automatically.
- **In-tree memory plugins**: `plugins/memory/` is **closed** to new in-tree backends. New backends must be published as standalone plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/` implementing the `MemoryProvider` ABC (`sync_turn`, `prefetch`, `shutdown`).

### Context management, tool limits, and goals
- **Tool call & turn limits**: Default turn limit is `agent.max_turns: 90` (override per session with `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`).
- **Context pruning**: `ContextCompressor` / `ContextEngine` trims and deduplicates older tool outputs while preserving recent context.
- **Long autonomous tasks**: Use `/goal <task>` (Ralph loop) for persistent cross-turn tasks that continue across turn limits. If execution pauses on budget exhaustion, resume with `/goal resume`.

---

## 4. Tools, Skills & Observability

### How do I add custom tools and track execution?
- **Custom tools**: Create standalone plugins under `~/.hermes/plugins/<name>` using `ctx.register_tool(...)` and enable them via `hermes plugins enable <name>`. Tools must belong to an enabled toolset.
- **Skill tracking**: Skill invocations are recorded in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json`. View execution counts and top skills with `hermes insights` or `/insights`.
- **Observability / Tracing**: For full call-chain traces, enable the bundled Langfuse plugin via `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse`.
- **MCP Media/Images**: MCP tool image outputs (`ImageContent`) are converted to `MEDIA:<path>` tags and forwarded to gateway adapters for native media rendering (v2026.5.7).

---

## 5. Gateway, Messaging & Web UI

### Web UI and API Server
- **Web Dashboard**: Run `hermes dashboard` to open the local web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:9119` with embedded terminal chat.
- **Open WebUI streaming / tool progress**: The bug where tool progress events failed to stream to Open WebUI was caused by a `TypeError` signature mismatch in `_on_tool_progress` (`gateway/platforms/api_server.py`), fixed in **v2026.4.8** (commit `7ec838507`).

### Messaging platforms (Telegram, Discord, Matrix, DingTalk, Email)
- **Interactive setup**: Run `hermes gateway setup` to configure platform tokens and allowlists without manual `.env` / `config.yaml` editing.
- **Telegram authorization**: `allowed_chats` configures group whitelists, not user DM permissions. To authorize user DMs, set `telegram.allow_from: "USER_ID"`, approve pairing via `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`, or set `telegram.allow_all: true`.
- **Telegram session preservation**: Telegram session resets on interruption were resolved in **v2026.5.7** (commit `f1e029251`), switching crash handling to `resume_pending` to preserve session history and transcripts. Absent `session_reset` defaults to `mode: none`.
- **File attachments**: Inbound text/code files (`.py`, `.txt`) are automatically injected into context prompts across Discord and Telegram. Outbound file delivery routes natively through platform adapters (Matrix `m.file`, SMTP email attachments, DingTalk Markdown image URLs `![image](url)`).
- **Multi-profile gateways & per-channel personas**: Use `channel_prompts` in platform configs for per-channel system prompts. Multi-profile gateways (`gateway.run`) allow multiplexing multiple bot accounts under isolated profile scopes. Subagents communicate via `delegate_task`.

---

## 6. Security & Vulnerability Reporting

Report security vulnerabilities confidentially via **GitHub Security Advisories** or email **security@nousresearch.com** per `SECURITY.md`. Do not open public issues.
